'''Savannah''' (Japanese: '''ツキコ''' ''Tsukiko'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. She is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] from [[Rubello Town]] and a member of the fan club [[Mothers for Pokémon]].

==History==
Savannah debuted in ''[[AG077|A Fan with a Plan]]'' alongside her fellow [[Mothers for Pokémon]] members. She was particularly excited to meet [[Drew]] and {{an|May}} at the [[Rubello Town]] [[Pokémon Center]]. May offered to battle Savannah, since Savannah was struggling to consider a strategy for an upcoming Contest. May also taught Savannah to do her best in each battle, even if the opponent is a friend. 

In ''[[AG078|Crusin' for a Losin']]'', Savannah and her {{p|Flareon}} performed well in the Appeals Round, earning themselves a place in the next round. When it came time to the semi-finals, she proved herself to be highly capable by defeating [[May's Bulbasaur]] with her {{p|Lairon}}. However, she lost in the finals to Drew's {{p|Masquerain}}.

Savannah and her daughter [[Sandra]] made brief cameos in ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', watching May compete in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]].

==Character==
Savannah was shown to be a very nervous {{pkmn|Coordinator}}, despite having won a [[Ribbon]] prior to her debut. Her past as a traveling {{pkmn|Trainer}} was briefly mentioned in ''[[AG077|A Fan with a Plan]]'', though she was too embarrassed to elaborate. She is also a very caring mother and her daughter [[Sandra]] sometimes helps her with creating strategies for Contests. She became a fan of {{an|May}} and [[Drew]] after seeing their performances in previous {{pkmn|Contest}}s.
